text:
Vile blooms
​
Introduction
Vile blooms are a combination task of all plant monsters on Anachronia. The main reason to do them is for the Lost Lands and Dungeons collection log, Skeka's hypnowand pieces, or to obtain their soul for 
​
⬥ Vile blooms can be assigned as a Slayer  assignment by Laniakea.
​
Desirable drops
⬥ Blast diffusion boots 
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Required for the Slayer collection log.
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 4 times rarer off-task.
⬥ Skeka's hypnowand pieces
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• All 4 pieces, but Skeka's hypnowand handle is twice as common.
⬥ Totem pieces
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Totem of Vitality middle
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Totem of Intimidation base
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Totem of Summoning middle
⬥ Dinosaur rib bone
⬥ Dinosaur tooth
​
Location and How to Get there
⬥ Helpful teleports include:
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Eastern Anachronia teleport 
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Anachronia lodestone 
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Laniakea  via 
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Locations via Orthen teleportation device.
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩  can help save time travelling.
​
